target_customer: Designers and front-end developers who want to build and publish websites and user interfaces visually
problem: Turning designs into working, published interfaces takes slow handoffs between design tools and code. Aspect aimed to make drawing a UI as easy as frames in Figma and publish it directly.

founders.name: Tshepo Mohlala
founders.background_notes: Listed as the only (former) founder on the YC page; a Pioneer.app winners profile exists for the same name. No education or employers found in opened sources.

competitors.name: Airbeam
competitors.what: Generates React, Vue or React Native code from Sketch designs

competitors.name: Fliplet
competitors.what: Visual app builder with open-source extensibility
competitors.traction_then: Fliplet 2.0 launch on Product Hunt, 158 upvotes

technical_complexity.rationale: A visual editor that exports and publishes real UI code is standard but demanding front-end engineering; a solo founder would need to build editor, code generation and hosting.

defensibility.rationale: Many no-code and design-to-code tools launched in 2019 and a one-person team had no data, network or integration moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established from sources; incumbents continued expanding in visual building, but no source ties them to Aspect's outcome.

market_need_then: Design-to-code handoff was a widely discussed pain and several visual UI builders launched on Product Hunt in 2019, showing demand but also crowding.

branding.community_and_virality: A LogRocket tutorial on dev.to shows Aspect used to build reusable React components, suggesting limited developer community use.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic dictionary word shared with many products (Aspect Build, Aspect software) and no evidence of brand-level press or community.

outcome_analysis: Aspect was a one-person YC Summer 2019 company building a visual UI builder; the YC page now lists the founder under former founders, the company has no website and no funding or news trail. The cause of any wind-down is not public, so no failure factors are asserted and the outcome stays unknown despite the directory status of Active.
notes: No company website exists in the dataset (dead or never public). StartupHub lists $10M total funding with no source, treated as unverified and not recorded as a round. Aspect Build (Bazel tooling, $3.85M seed in 2024) is a different company. Directory status Active conflicts with the founder being listed as former; real status unknown. Competitor sources are Product Hunt launches from October 2019, about four months after the batch, and are loose matches.
